topicName: Media Language, Representation, Industries and Audiences

steps.title: Stuart Hall's Reception Theory
steps.body: Media texts are encoded by producers with preferred meanings, but decoded by audiences as Preferred, Negotiated, or Oppositional.

steps.title: Semiotic Denotation and Connotation
steps.body: Denotation is the literal meaning of a sign; connotation is the associated cultural and emotional interpretation.
